A '''copper shovel''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], crafted from one [[copper ingot]] and two sticks. It digs at speed 6 and has 350 durability.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed 6 (vanilla: 5). Because its mining rule is marked as correct for drops, it collects snowballs from snow like vanilla shovels. The pack also makes dirt slabs (petrified oak slabs) shovel blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/shovel.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|3.5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]], it can be melted down into a single copper ingot. It is also the base item for the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] and [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] upgrades at a [[smithing table]].
